Audience: every first-time Nevada Basic Class C applicant; this is the core of what the knowledge test checks.
Why it matters to a first-timer: sign colors and shapes must be read at a glance [A02], and the signal rules decide who moves at every intersection [A04].
Level: high-volume recall with many confusable pairs (yellow light versus yellow arrows, right versus left on red, white versus yellow lines) plus exact distances and speeds.
Prerequisites: sec01 to sec03 for licensing context; no prior driving-skill chapter is needed.
